map.本工具能替代按压反馈设备吗？: Can this tool replace the compression feedback device?
map.不能，仅作区间参考，实际以反馈仪与按压质量监测为准。: No; it only gives a range. Actual feedback and quality monitoring govern.
map.每次充分回弹保证心充盈，避免倚靠，必要时轮换按压者。: Recoil fully each time to fill the heart; avoid leaning; rotate compressors if needed.
